designRationale: The heritage-opulence archetype demands deep navy and burgundy tones with gold accents, expressing luxury and tradition. The class choices use bg-brand-primary gradient for the rich brand color, text-text-inverted for contrast on dark backgrounds, generous spacing with gap-hero, and grid layout for formal two-column presentation. The before:absolute overlay with bg-brand-primary/60 adds depth and sophistication appropriate for luxury heritage properties.
